def scenario_controller_checkpoint():
    """The controller vectors and the scaled dual survive a restore."""
    case = base()
    case['quorum'] = 1
    case['events'] = [
        {'op': 'issue', 'id': 1, 'worker': 0},
        {'op': 'issue', 'id': 2, 'worker': 1},
        {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 1},
        {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 2},
        {'op': 'step'},                # advance: z and u are set
        {'op': 'save', 'name': 3},
        {'op': 'retune', 'rho': 5},    # rescale the dual
        {'op': 'step'},                # blocked (fresh set was cleared)
        {'op': 'audit'},
        {'op': 'restore', 'name': 3},
        {'op': 'audit'},
    ]
    events = run({'cases': [case]})['cases'][0]['events']
    advanced = events[4]
    expect('advanced', advanced['status'], 'advanced')
    before = events[8]
    after = events[10]
    expect('dual rescaled by the retune', before['dual'],
           [value / 5.0 for value in advanced['dual']])
    expect('consensus vector kept', before['z'], advanced['z'])
    expect('restored consensus vector', after['z'], advanced['z'])
    expect('restored dual', after['dual'], advanced['dual'])
    expect('restored rho', after['rho'], 1)
    expect('restored round', after['round'], 1)
    expect('restored load', after['load'], advanced['load'])
    expect('restored seen', after['seen'], [0, 1])
    expect('restored age', after['age'], [0, 0])


def scenario_restore_invalidates_proposals():
    """A proposal of an older generation is obsolete after a restore."""

    expect('restore generation', events[2], {'op': 'restore', 'name': 2, 'generation': 1})

    expect('accepted after restore', events[5], {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 3, 'status': 'accepted'})
    expect('audit generation', events[6]['generation'], 1)
